population: Human camera wearer; not a spectator, room camera, robot, or video-game character
question: Can the supplied visual evidence distinguish a staged wearer fall from an ordinary non-fall movement?

sampling.environment: Publisher Indoor directories for both classes. Visual inspection found outdoor-looking walking footage under Indoor; matched environments are NOT established and must be reviewed before scoring shortcuts.
sampling.selection: Deterministic SHA-256 ranking within scenario families; round-robin scenario allocation. No selection based on model outputs or visual ease.
sampling.deduplication: Exclude equal byte-length/CRC32 candidates before sampling; verify whole-file SHA-256 after download; do not distribute a subject across splits.
sampling.caveat: Participant separation does not establish collection-session/environment independence. Mount labels have source anomalies. Public pretraining overlap is unknown.

preparation.output: Six-frame chronological JPEG montage, 768 x 464, no EXIF, neutral opaque filename
preparation.audio: Original clips retained, but audio is not passed to the image/text-only app interface
preparation.caveat: Whole-clip labels do not prove that the fall is visible in the sampled frames. Annotate visibility before interpreting individual errors. Sampling includes post-event context; this does not test real-time detection or detection delay.

model_modes.summary: Calls the unchanged application summarizer with neutral text and the montage. Human review required. Does not produce a detection-accuracy number.
model_modes.classify: Separate experimental prompt using the configured Nemotron provider. Returns fall, nonfall, or uncertain; cannot operate app alerts. This is not the deployed summarizer.

leakage_controls: Never send source labels, scenario names, subject IDs, source paths, split names, or dataset captions to the model
Keep the test split untouched for prompt/threshold development
Record prompt, implementation, manifest, and prepared-image hashes

human_review.status: Publisher labels retained; independent adjudication pending
human_review.procedure: Use two independent reviewers blinded to source label, then adjudicate disagreements against the original video. Do not relabel an unclear clip as an ordinary/safe situation.

metrics: Confusion matrix including uncertainty and inference errors
uncertainty_policy: Abstentions and inference errors remain in denominators; they never count as correct nonfall predictions.

blockers: Live model evaluation deferred at user request; no inference results exist.
Only six positive test clips and six ordinary test clips
No continuous ordinary-life denominator for false alerts per armed hour
No onset annotations or latency assessment
Promotion thresholds have not been agreed
readiness.next_measurement: After the initial screening, collect consented head-mounted/real-glasses data, longer ordinary sessions, matched hard negatives, and safely staged wearer-perspective events. Evaluate separately from this public body-camera proxy.

live_evaluation: Deferred at user request; prepare data and evaluation tools only.
